dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'C' and 'O' shaped structures are visible on the lateral flank. The largest 'C' shape in the mid-section features a high-contrast, jagged light-gray perimeter (approx. 2-3 pixels wide) transitioning into a darker interior. Posterior to this is a closed 'O' shape with a softer gradient transition. A third irregular 'C' shape is located on the lower-mid flank with a sharply defined upper arc.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density. A single, high-intensity rectangular cluster of white pixels (approx. 10x5 pixel area) is located on the lower lateral mid-body. A secondary cluster of three micro-blobs is visible near the posterior insertion of the pectoral flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the two largest lateral macro-annuli and the mid-body high-intensity rectangular blob form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge connecting the two annuli along the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Five elongated, dark-pigmented keratinized claws are clearly visible and well-separated on the distal edge of the pectoral flipper.
